Which public definitions in ddflow.api.lifecycle area modules are not re-exported from the package __init__?
plan_for_offer is the ONLY public definition in the ddflow.api.lifecycle area modules that __init__.py fails to re-export; adding it to line 37 makes the layout test pass.
planning.py:72 defines plan_for_offer; __init__.py imported only PURPOSES/alternatives_offer/plan_for, so getattr(LC,'plan_for_offer') is None and the layout test fails.

evidence.note: CONFIRMED: AST scan shows planning->plan_for_offer is the only lifecycle re-export missing; research note added to B0864b9309a (duplicate_of). Fix commit 13d2cd795 adds plan_for_offer to __init__.py line 37.
